question: ¿En cuántas concesiones con algún posible venteo satelital desde 2024 el gasoducto de transporte de ENARGAS más cercano está a 10 km o más del contorno?

attempts.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, anillo::jsonb a FROM sig_energia.concesion WHERE anillo ~ '^\s*\['
), cr AS (
  SELECT id_concesion,
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a->0->0)='number' THEN jsonb_build_array(a)
         WHEN jsonb_typeof(a->0->0->0)='number' THEN a
         ELSE (SELECT jsonb_agg(r) FROM jsonb_array_elements(a) poly, jsonb_array_elements(poly) r) END rings
  FROM c
), cp AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, rn, i, (p->>0)::float lon, (p->>1)::float lat
  FROM cr, jsonb_array_elements(rings) WITH ORDINALITY r(ring, rn), jsonb_array_elements(ring) WITH ORDINALITY q(p, i)
), ce AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, lon x1, lat y1,
    coalesce(lead(lon) OVER w, first_value(lon) OVER w) x2,
    coalesce(lead(lat) OVER w, first_value(lat) OVER w) y2
  FROM cp WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY id_concesion, rn ORDER BY i)
), bb AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, min(lon) mnx, max(lon) mxx, min(lat) mny, max(lat) mxy, cos(radians(avg(lat))) k FROM cp GROUP BY 1
), v AS (
  SELECT gml_id, lon, lat FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado WHERE fecha >= date '2024-01-01'
), cand AS (
  SELECT b.id_concesion, v.gml_id, v.lon, v.lat FROM bb b JOIN v ON v.lon BETWEEN mnx AND mxx AND v.lat BETWEEN mny AND mxy
), dentro AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT q.id_concesion, q.gml_id FROM cand q JOIN ce e ON e.id_concesion = q.id_concesion
    WHERE (e.y1 > q.lat) <> (e.y2 > q.lat) AND q.lon < (e.x2-e.x1)*(q.lat-e.y1)/(e.y2-e.y1) + e.x1
    GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1) z
), g AS (
  SELECT gml_id, lineas::jsonb l FROM enargas.gasoducto WHERE lineas ~ '^\s*\['
), gr AS (
  SELECT gml_id,
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(l->0->0)='number' THEN jsonb_build_array(l)
         WHEN jsonb_typeof(l->0->0->0)='number' THEN l
         ELSE (SELECT jsonb_agg(r) FROM jsonb_array_elements(l) m, jsonb_array_elements(m) r) END lines
  FROM g
), gp AS (
  SELECT gml_id, ln, i, (p->>0)::float lon, (p->>1)::float lat
  FROM gr, jsonb_array_elements(lines) WITH ORDINALITY r(line, ln), jsonb_array_elements(line) WITH ORDINALITY q(p, i)
), ge AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT lon gx1, lat gy1, lead(lon) OVER w gx2, lead(lat) OVER w gy2
    FROM gp WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY gml_id, ln ORDER BY i)) s WHERE gx2 IS NOT NULL
), pares AS (
  SELECT e.id_concesion,
    e.x1*111.32*b.k ax, e.y1*110.574 ay, e.x2*111.32*b.k bx, e.y2*110.574 by_,
    g.gx1*111.32*b.k cx, g.gy1*110.574 cy, g.gx2*111.32*b.k dx, g.gy2*110.574 dy
  FROM dentro d JOIN bb b USING (id_concesion) JOIN ce e USING (id_concesion)
  JOIN ge g ON least(g.gx1,g.gx2) <= greatest(e.x1,e.x2)+0.15 AND greatest(g.gx1,g.gx2) >= least(e.x1,e.x2)-0.15
           AND least(g.gy1,g.gy2) <= greatest(e.y1,e.y2)+0.12 AND greatest(g.gy1,g.gy2) >= least(e.y1,e.y2)-0.12
), dist AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, min(
    CASE WHEN ((bx-ax)*(cy-ay)-(by_-ay)*(cx-ax)) * ((bx-ax)*(dy-ay)-(by_-ay)*(dx-ax)) < 0
          AND ((dx-cx)*(ay-cy)-(dy-cy)*(ax-cx)) * ((dx-cx)*(by_-cy)-(dy-cy)*(bx-cx)) < 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (SELECT min(sqrt((px-sx-t*(ex-sx))^2 + (py-sy-t*(ey-sy))^2)) FROM (
            SELECT px, py, sx, sy, ex, ey,
              CASE WHEN (ex-sx)^2+(ey-sy)^2 = 0 THEN 0
                   ELSE greatest(0, least(1, ((px-sx)*(ex-sx)+(py-sy)*(ey-sy))/((ex-sx)^2+(ey-sy)^2))) END t
            FROM (VALUES (ax,ay,cx,cy,dx,dy),(bx,by_,cx,cy,dx,dy),(cx,cy,ax,ay,bx,by_),(dx,dy,ax,ay,bx,by_)) vv(px,py,sx,sy,ex,ey)) tt)
    END) dmin
  FROM pares GROUP BY 1
), gasdentro AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT b.id_concesion, p.gml_id, p.ln, p.i, p.lon, p.lat
    FROM dentro d JOIN bb b USING (id_concesion) JOIN gp p ON p.lon BETWEEN b.mnx AND b.mxx AND p.lat BETWEEN b.mny AND b.mxy) q
  JOIN ce e USING (id_concesion)
  WHERE (e.y1 > q.lat) <> (e.y2 > q.lat) AND q.lon < (e.x2-e.x1)*(q.lat-e.y1)/(e.y2-e.y1) + e.x1
  GROUP BY q.id_concesion, q.gml_id, q.ln, q.i HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1
)
SELECT count(*) FROM dentro d
WHERE coalesce((SELECT dmin FROM dist WHERE dist.id_concesion = d.id_concesion), 1e9) >= 10
  AND d.id_concesion NOT IN (SELECT id_concesion FROM gasdentro)
